cases.question: ¿Cuántos periodos contables abiertos abarcan marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM accounting_period ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < DATE '2026-04-01' AND ap.end_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de comprobantes emitidos en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-05-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_comprobantes FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se facturó por cada tipo de comprobante en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY si.voucher_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type AS tipo_comprobante, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total_facturado FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY si.voucher_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se cobró por cada medio de pago en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio, SUM(sp.amount) AS total FROM sales_payment sp JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.id = sp.payment_type_id WHERE sp.paid_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND sp.paid_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pt.name AS payment_type, SUM(sp.amount) AS total_collected FROM public.sales_payment AS sp JOIN public.payment_type AS pt ON sp.payment_type_id = pt.id WHERE sp.paid_at >= CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND sp.paid_at < CAST('2026-05-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY pt.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos pedidos cerrados para llevar hubo en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM sales_order so WHERE so.order_type = 'Llevar' AND so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-05-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_pedidos FROM public.sales_order AS a WHERE a.order_type = 'Llevar' AND a.status = 'Closed' AND a.ordered_at >= CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND a.ordered_at < CAST('2026-05-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué productos vendieron más unidades en pedidos cerrados durante abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS unidades FROM sales_order so JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = so.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND p.sellable = TRUE AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 5
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_unidades FROM public.order_item AS oi JOIN public.sales_order AS so ON oi.order_id = so.id JOIN public.product AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE so.order_type = 'Llevar' AND so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND so.ordered_at < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_unidades DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total vendido por canal de pedido en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT so.order_type, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total FROM sales_order so JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = so.id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY so.order_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT so.order_type AS canal, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total_vendido FROM public.sales_invoice AS si JOIN public.sales_order AS so ON si.order_id = so.id WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY so.order_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuántos pedidos cerrados se atendieron en cada mesa durante abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT dt.number AS mesa, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS pedidos FROM sales_order so JOIN order_table ot ON ot.order_id = so.id JOIN dining_table dt ON dt.id = ot.table_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.order_type = 'Mesa' AND so.ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND so.ordered_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY dt.id, dt.number ORDER BY dt.number LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT dt.number AS mesa, COUNT(dt.order_id) AS total_pedidos FROM (SELECT t.number AS number, ot.order_id AS order_id FROM public.dining_table AS t JOIN public.order_table AS ot ON ot.table_id = t.id JOIN public.sales_order AS so ON so.id = ot.order_id WHERE so.status = 'Closed' AND so.ordered_at >= '2026-04-01' AND so.ordered_at < '2026-05-01') AS dt GROUP BY dt.number LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de facturas de compra activas en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pi.total_amount), 0) AS total FROM purchase_invoice pi WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-05-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(pi.total_amount) AS total_facturas_compra FROM public.purchase_invoice AS pi WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se compró a cada proveedor en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, SUM(pi.total_amount) AS total FROM purchase_invoice pi JOIN supplier s ON s.id = pi.supplier_id WHERE pi.active = TRUE AND pi.issued_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND pi.issued_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY s.id, s.business_name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT s.business_name AS proveedor, COALESCE(SUM(pi.total_amount), 0) AS total_compras FROM public.supplier AS s JOIN public.purchase_invoice AS pi ON pi.supplier_id = s.id WHERE pi.issued_at >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND pi.issued_at < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.business_name LIMIT 50
